card.name: Linking words in food-prep instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (and, a, on, into, over, the) in cooking or capsule-sprinkling directions, right where a place or container for food is about to be named.

modes.label: Cooking steps
modes.description: The word 'and' or a comma in recipe-style directions about placing food on or in something.
modes.example: Transfer to serving dish<< and>> place chicken on top of the vegetable mixture

modes.label: Sprinkling capsule contents
modes.description: A preposition after capsule contents, naming the soft food or cup they go on or into.
modes.example: XTAMPZA ER can also be taken by sprinkling the capsule contents<< on>> soft foods or sprinkling the contents into

modes.label: Pouring into a container
modes.description: An article or preposition just before a clean cup or bowl in mixing directions.
modes.example: Pour approximately 4 ounces (½ cup) of fruit juice into<< a>> clean cup.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'top' and 'Top', as in 'on top of' placement phrases.
card.plain: It fires on little words in directions for putting or sprinkling food or medicine onto or into something.
